PORTFOLIO DIGEST — 2026-07-28 (14 updates)

POWER & UTILITIES
- Bernstein initiated/reiterated 'Outperform' on Tata Power, JSW Energy and NTPC, with target prices implying 23-34% upside (Tata Power Rs 430, JSW Energy Rs 623, NTPC Rs 450). Published July 22, 2026.
  https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/tata-power-adani-green-ntpc-jsw-energy-shares-bernstein-targets-what-investors-should-chase-544422-2026-07-22

INDUSTRIALS & CAPITAL GOODS
- ABB India hit a fresh all-time high (Rs 7,924.50, +10%) on July 16, 2026 after parent ABB Ltd reported 81% YoY India order-inflow growth in Q2 2026, well ahead of the ~20% analysts expected. ABB India's own Q1 FY27 results are due July 31.
  https://www.business-standard.com/amp/markets/capital-market-news/abb-india-spurts-after-parent-highlights-robust-india-order-inflows-126071600737_1.html

METALS & MINING
- JSW Steel Q1 FY27: consolidated net profit more than doubled YoY to Rs 4,696 crore (from Rs 2,209 crore), revenue up to Rs 47,364 crore, EBITDA +38% YoY to Rs 9,383 crore on record Q1 sales volumes. Reported July 17, 2026.
  https://www.business-standard.com/companies/quarterly-results/jsw-steel-q1fy27-profit-revenue-ebitda-results-126071700690_1.html

INTERNET
- Eternal (Zomato) Q1 FY27: net profit Rs 92 crore, revenue +182% YoY to Rs 20,211 crore, driven by food delivery and Blinkit quick-commerce growth. Also announced transfer of its 'Nugget' business to subsidiary Carthero Technologies for Rs 350 crore as part of internal restructuring.
  https://www.deccanherald.com/business/companies/zomatos-parent-eternal-reports-q1-2026-net-profit-of-rs-92-crore-revenue-jumps-182-yoy-to-rs-20211-crore-4083413
  https://www.freepressjournal.in/business/zomato-parent-eternal-reports-92-crore-profit-for-q1-fy27-announces-business-transfer

BANKING
- ICICI Bank Q1 FY27: consolidated net profit up 13.9% YoY to Rs 15,440 crore (standalone +15.9% to Rs 14,804 crore); NII +12.7% to Rs 24,384 crore; asset quality improved (gross NPA 1.38% vs 1.67% a year ago). Reported ~July 18-20, 2026.
  https://www.business-standard.com/companies/quarterly-results/icici-bank-q1fy27-profit-rises-14-to-15-440-crore-nii-rises-12-3-126071800571_1.html

FINANCIAL SERVICES / NBFC
- CreditAccess Grameen Q1 FY27: PAT surged 720% YoY to Rs 493 crore as credit costs normalized and asset quality recovered (GNPA 2.18%, collection efficiency 97.4%); AUM up 16.4% YoY to Rs 30,319 crore. Management called it one of the strongest Q1s in company history. Reported July 24-25, 2026.
  https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/creditaccess-grameen-q1-fy27-slides-profit-surges-720-asset-quality-normalizes-93CH-4812042

REAL ESTATE & HOSPITALITY
- Prestige Estates acquired a 50% stake in Advent Convention & Hotels International for Rs 504 crore (agreement dated July 3, 2026) to develop a ~1.5 million sq ft commercial project in Sahar, Andheri, Mumbai (est. GDV Rs 4,500 crore).
  https://www.business-standard.com/industry/news/prestige-estates-acquires-50-stake-in-advent-hotels-for-504-crore-126070600494_1.html

ELECTRONICS MANUFACTURING
- Dixon Technologies: government approved (July 8, 2026) the Vivo-Dixon smartphone manufacturing JV (Dixon to hold 51%). Separately, Dixon's own Q1 FY27 results are scheduled for a board meeting/call on July 31, 2026.
  https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/dixon-technologies-stock-in-focus-on-jv-update-with-vivo-india-542145-2026-07-10
  https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/dixon-technologies-q1-results-earnings-call-scheduled-for-july-31/46455848

TELECOM
- Bharti Airtel fixed July 24, 2026 as the record date for a Rs 24/share final dividend, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM on August 3, 2026.
  https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/rs-24-dividend-per-share-bharti-airtel-fixes-record-date-for-payment-check-details-542177-2026-07-10

FERTILIZERS & CHEMICALS
- Paradeep Phosphates: board meets TODAY (July 28, 2026) to approve Q1 FY27 results and a Performance Stock Option Plan 2026. Separately, its rating was upgraded from Sell to Hold on July 22, 2026 on improving technicals, after FY26 net profit grew 52% YoY to Rs 1,000 crore.
  https://www.sahi.com/news/paradeep-phosphates-scheduled-to-review-q1-financial-results-2835-PE1_COR
  https://www.marketsmojo.com/news/stock-recommendation/paradeep-phosphates-ltd-upgraded-to-hold-as-technicals-improve-amid-mixed-financials-4117255

HEALTHCARE
- KIMS (Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences) approved a preferential issue of 77 lakh warrants to promoters at Rs 779 each, raising Rs 600 crore (EGM July 9, 2026), earmarked to retire debt and fund new hospital projects.
  https://www.kotakneo.com/news/stocks/kims-77-lakh-warrants-600-crore-promoters-preferential-issue-egm-july-2026/

AUTO COMPONENTS
- Sona Comstar (Sona BLW) Q1 FY27: revenue +54% YoY to Rs 1,310 crore, EBITDA +49% to Rs 303 crore (23.1% margin), PAT +45% to Rs 181 crore; won three new orders (EV, hybrid, ICE). Reported July 23, 2026.
  https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/SONACOMS_23072026165213_PressRelease.pdf

CONGLOMERATE / ENERGY
- Reliance Industries Q1 FY27: consolidated net profit fell 24.6% YoY to Rs 23,196 crore on higher oil prices/lower margins, even as revenue rose 25.4% to Rs 3,11,850 crore and recurring EBITDA hit a record Rs 54,067 crore (+10.1% YoY). Reported July 17, 2026. Separately, RIL received an administrative warning from SEBI around July 6, 2026.
  https://www.freepressjournal.in/business/reliance-industries-q1-fy27-profit-declines-to-23001-crore-revenue-rises-to-312-lakh-crore

IT SERVICES
- Birlasoft: board meets TODAY (July 28, 2026) to approve Q1 FY27 results, with an earnings call at 5:30 PM IST the same day.
  https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/birlasoft-to-host-q1fy27-earnings-call-on-july-28-2026/46165069

---
No material news surfaced today for: Defense (MAZDOCK, BEL, ZENTEC, GRSE, BDL, SOLARINDS, AVANTEL, DATAPATTNS), Capital Markets & Exchanges (CDSL, MCX, BSE), the uncategorized names (CPPLUS, INOXINDIA, GARFIBRES, KRN-BE, PTCIL, ROTO, ATLANTAELE, VOGL, VISL), NATIONALUM/VAML/VEDL/JINDALSAW/VEDPOWER, MAFANG, POLYCAB/KEI, MOTILALOFS, TATACOMM, and NETWORK18.
